title: C4OS Grill Question 002B - Runtime Tool Discovery And Invocation

questions.label: Without app plugins enabled, what can the runtime do with Tauri tools?
questions.help: Recommended: runtime can discover tool metadata, but invocation requires app-shell policy or enabled app-plugin declaration. This preserves the MCP-like list_tools model while preventing dormant tools from becoming silently executable.
options: Discover metadata only; invocation requires app-shell policy or enabled app-plugin declaration
Discover and invoke any registered backend tool if tool-level approval policy allows it
No discovery or invocation unless an app plugin is enabled

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether tool availability is global, per-session, per-workspace, per-plugin, or controlled by model/runtime adapter.
